lines.1: 「Tsushima, I hear you're a siscon. What a sorry bastard.」
lines.3: 「I understand. I've got twelve little sisters myself.」
lines.4: That was the most unpleasant sympathy I'd ever received.
lines.5: 「Hmph... Every man in the kempo club is furious that the universally adored Kurogane has found herself a boyfriend.」
lines.6: ...Word had already spread that far, huh?
lines.7: 「So? What's the truth? You two are dating, aren't you?」
lines.9: 「Damn, so it's true. If you were merely a siscon, I was going to introduce you to one of my twelve sisters.」
lines.20: 「You two had a whole summer to get over it. Are you still fighting?」
lines.21: 「We both apologized, so that part is settled...」
lines.23: 「Now there's this weird gap between us, and I don't know how close to act...」
lines.24: Whoa. These two were painfully innocent.
lines.29: 「Oh, right. Our teacher brought up the class trip in homeroom today. We have to choose a destination soon.」
lines.30: Our choices were England, Chongqing, Sweden, or the Appalachian Mountains.
lines.31: They'd already made us get passports, but choosing the place still mattered.
lines.33: 「Yoshimi wants Sweden, and it looks like the student council crowd will go with her.」
lines.34: Otome's group had apparently gone to the Appalachians. (The kempo club made it mandatory.)
lines.39: 「And I want you to call me at least once at night while you're there.」
lines.42: ...She always looked me in the eye and told me exactly what she wanted. You couldn't misunderstand her.
lines.43: 「If we go somewhere together, it'll probably be during winter break.」
lines.44: 「I always go snowboarding with the three idiots I grew up with.」
lines.46: 「Yes. That sounds fun. There will be sports, of course, but hot springs too, correct? And good food?」
lines.47: Seriously, she was an open book.
lines.51: 「We can watch the leaves together... take a boat out, then climb to the top of the mountain.」
lines.52: 「Ahaha. Just imagining it makes me happy.」
lines.54: 「Sounds great, but can I afford it?」
lines.55: 「I invited you. It will be my treat.」
lines.56: Leave it to me, she declared, thumping her chest.
lines.57: Hmm. She had a woman's heart and a man's gallantry all in one.
